Title: Unauthenticated user successfully accesses API documentation via Swagger UI
Preconditions: User is not logged in to the application. API documentation is deployed and accessible.
Steps:
1. Open a web browser. 2. Navigate to the application's Swagger UI URL (e.g., 'https://[app-url]/swagger-ui/index.html'). 3. Observe the API documentation interface.

Test Data: Swagger UI URL: 'https://[app-url]/swagger-ui/index.html'
Expected Result: The Swagger UI interface loads successfully, displaying the API title 'Shop API', version 'v1.0', and a list of available API endpoints without requiring authentication.

Title: Shop owner successfully updates an existing slot's time range without overlapping other slots
Preconditions: User is logged in as a shop owner. The shop has at least one active slot (e.g., MORNING: 09:00-12:00). No other slots overlap with the new time range (e.g., 10:00-13:00).
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Slot Management' section in the shop dashboard. 2. Select the existing MORNING slot. 3. Update the start time to '10:00' and end time to '13:00'. 4. Click 'Save Changes'. 5. Verify the updated slot details in the slot list.

Test Data: Slot type: MORNING, Original time: 09:00-12:00, Updated time: 10:00-13:00
Expected Result: A success message 'Slot updated successfully.' is displayed. The MORNING slot now shows the updated time range (10:00-13:00) and remains active (isActive: true) in the slot list.

Title: Shop owner successfully deactivates an existing slot for the shop
Preconditions: User is logged in as a shop owner. The shop has at least one active slot (e.g., MORNING: 09:00-12:00).
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Slot Management' section in the shop dashboard. 2. Select the existing MORNING slot. 3. Click 'Deactivate Slot'. 4. Confirm the deactivation in the popup dialog. 5. Verify the slot status in the slot list.

Test Data: Slot type: MORNING, Time: 09:00-12:00
Expected Result: A success message 'Slot deactivated successfully.' is displayed. The MORNING slot now shows as inactive (isActive: false) in the slot list.
